# Incident with Git Operations, Issues, Actions and Pull Requests

## What Changed

Oct 7, 18:04 UTC Resolved - On October 7, 2026, from 16:52 to 17:01 UTC, GitHub experienced a recurrence of the write-operation outage from earlier that day. Both outages shared the same root cause. Please refer to the combined summary covering both incidents, their impact, and our prevention measures: https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/djlmxz2zd0j7 Oct 7, 18:00 UTC Update - All systems have recovered. We have applied mitigations and do not anticipate another recurrence. Oct 7, 17:27 UTC Monitoring - The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Oct 7, 17:25 UTC Update - We observed widespread impact across GitHub services from 16:52 UTC to 17:01 UTC, and are investigating the root cause. All systems have recovered. This incident is a reoccurrence of the incident from earlier in the day https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/djlmxz2zd0j7. Durable mitigation is in progress. We will provide another update in 30 minutes. Oct 7, 17:17 UTC Investigating - We are investigating reports of degraded performance for Actions, Git Operations, Issues and Pull Requests
